tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production sprite source for educational YouTube videos. Create a strict3 by3 row-major grid of NINE full-body poses, every cell equal size. Highest native resolution available, transparent RGBA background. Input image1 is the EXACT adopted identity/style reference, not a pixel-edit target. Redraw fresh. The exact adopted Komodo Dragon shown in image1; identity features: 灰褐色の斑・丸い広い吻・一本の太尾. Preserve the reference’s large head, exact torso LENGTH and WIDTH, short upright two-legged body and two arm-like forepaws. Never shorten/slim the torso or enlarge the head relative to it. Keep exactly the existing2 arms,2 legs and existing tail/horns/ears; do not create a tail on a tailless reference. Preserve its exact eye format when open (white surrounds only if the reference has them, same pupil and no added highlights), facial markings, palette, warm brown contours and subtle paper/watercolor texture. No realistic animal proportions or heavy outline change. All poses keep SAME anatomical head/body scale and proportions as the adopted reference, including every resting/blink/crouch state. Lots of true transparent padding around each complete subject and between cells; no cropped horns/gills/bill/tail/feet. No text, labels, grid lines, backgrounds, ground/shadow, props, sparkles, extra animals or duplicate/disconnected limbs. Required reading order left-to-right then top-to-bottom: 1 BLINK: Same exact upright/resting body position, head size, torso length/width, limbs, supports and facing as image1, ONLY the eye(s) gently fully closed as a simple brown lid curve; mouth/expression otherwise unchanged. Do not crouch, nod, shrink or move the body during blink. 2 GREET: Friendly one-forepaw gentle raised greeting, feet planted and head/body scale unchanged. 3 PRESENT_LEFT: Connected forepaw/arm indicates VIEWER LEFT and gaze follows, feet remain planted. 4 PRESENT_RIGHT: Connected forepaw/arm indicates VIEWER RIGHT and gaze follows, feet remain planted. Generate a fresh matching opposite gesture, not a flip-copy. 5 THINK: One existing forepaw gently touches chin, curious head tilt, torso stable. 6 AHA: Small pleased discovery reaction: head perks and one forepaw slightly lifts, friendly eyes; no lightbulb/effect. 7 CHEER: Gentle pleased grounded celebration, two connected forepaws comfortably lifted, smiling closed eyes allowed; no jump or new props. 8 SPECIES_A: Keep the upright two-arm/two-foot mascot design and gently curl only the existing tail tip slightly upward. 9 SPECIES_B: The same tail tip settles part-way toward its neutral curve; preserve head projection, arms and planted feet. Species constraint: 自然な四足歩行体へ戻さない。青い斑・背の突起・長い吻・細い尾など個体の採用形を維持し、尾を足や腕へ変えない。 Clean bounded color areas and connected silhouettes; no pigment spills, background haze or extra marks. Do not insert an additional neutral; it is reused from image1.
